assessment.security_status_en: The Asia-Pacific region faces heightened volatility following tech shocks triggered by Chinese innovations (DeepSeek) and Beijing's new export controls on AI, biopharma, and solar tech. Simultaneously, Japan and South Korea are stepping up cyber defense and military modernization amid rising regional threats. In Southeast Asia, environmental haze crises and political instability continue to disrupt domestic operations.

assessment.forecast_review_cs: Předchozí předpověď se plně potvrdila; nedávné AI šoky a obavy vyvolané čínským vývojem skutečně vedly k silnému odklonu od rizikových aktiv a k posílení bezpečných přístavů.
assessment.forecast_review_en: The previous forecast was fully confirmed; recent AI shocks and concerns sparked by Chinese developments indeed triggered a strong flight from risk assets and a strengthening of safe havens.
